findings.description: The interpreter assumes the system must add event listeners to Circuit Height fields and update the UI dynamically; the ticket only specifies that the DX Coil Height should be populated and summed, not how or when UI updates occur.
The interpreter includes validation that circuit height inputs are numeric before summing, which is not mentioned in the ticket and therefore an unsupported assumption.
The interpreter mentions handling scenarios where no circuits are present (display empty or zero); the ticket does not define this behavior, making it an assumed requirement.

The interpreter states that the DX Coil Height must be updated when the user alters a Circuit Height; while implied, the ticket does not explicitly require real‑time recalculation on edit, so this is an inferred requirement.
